items.title: ExcelMania 1.0
items.summary: An advanced Excel competition on a textile orders dataset: data cleaning, formula-driven analysis and an interactive dashboard.
items.context: An advanced Excel competition built on a textile orders dataset of about 1,000 order lines for January to September 2026, with seven tasks: data cleaning, formulas, analysis and summary, advanced analysis, an interactive dashboard, data-driven insights and an analytical report.
approach: Cleaned the raw orders with an issue register and cleaning log.
Built auditable formula-driven analysis of sales, operations and targets.
Built an interactive performance dashboard filtered by month, factory, category, region and salesperson.
items.outcome: 1st Runner-Up. Key findings from my solution:
outcome_points: Only 31.2% of orders shipped on time, traced to promised lead times shorter than real lead times across every factory: a planning issue, not one weak plant.
